title: Read an existing class
prompt: Import Board from ./board.js. Export countOpen(board: Board): number. Use its all() method and count the tasks whose done flag is false. Do not change the board.
hints: Read the method contract, then decide which tasks count.
all() returns the tasks. Each task has a boolean done field.
Count only tasks for which done is false.
checks: (() => { const tasks = Object.freeze([Object.freeze({title:"A",done:false})]); answer.countOpen(new Board(tasks)); return tasks.length === 1; })()

wrongAnswers.misconception: Returns the worked-example result for every board.

feedback: Read the method contract, then decide which tasks count.
